name: CustomerID
description: unique subscriber identifier

name: Churn
description: target: whether the customer churned (Yes/No)

name: MonthlyRevenue
description: mean monthly revenue (USD)

name: MonthlyMinutes
description: mean monthly minutes of use

name: TotalRecurringCharge
description: mean total monthly recurring charge (USD)

name: DirectorAssistedCalls
description: mean number of directory-assisted calls per month

name: OverageMinutes
description: mean monthly minutes used beyond the plan allowance

name: RoamingCalls
description: mean number of roaming calls per month

name: PercChangeMinutes
description: percentage change in minutes of use versus the previous period

name: PercChangeRevenues
description: percentage change in revenue versus the previous period

name: DroppedCalls
description: mean number of dropped voice calls per month

name: BlockedCalls
description: mean number of blocked (failed connection) calls per month

name: UnansweredCalls
description: mean number of unanswered calls per month

name: CustomerCareCalls
description: mean number of calls placed to customer care per month

name: ThreewayCalls
description: mean number of three-way calls per month

name: ReceivedCalls
description: mean number of inbound calls received per month

name: OutboundCalls
description: mean number of outbound calls placed per month

name: InboundCalls
description: mean number of inbound calls per month

name: PeakCallsInOut
description: mean number of inbound and outbound calls during peak hours

name: OffPeakCallsInOut
description: mean number of inbound and outbound calls during off-peak hours

name: DroppedBlockedCalls
description: mean number of dropped or blocked calls per month (intended to equal DroppedCalls + BlockedCalls)
notes: inconsistent with DroppedCalls + BlockedCalls in about 19.6% of rows, see Table 11

name: CallForwardingCalls
description: mean number of call-forwarding calls per month

name: CallWaitingCalls
description: mean number of call-waiting calls per month

name: MonthsInService
description: months since account activation

name: UniqueSubs
description: number of unique subscribers on the account

name: ActiveSubs
description: number of active subscribers on the account

name: ServiceArea
description: service area code: 3-letter market + 3-letter city + 3-digit telephone area code
notes: 747 levels; first 3 characters encode a 57-level market, see Task 3 Figure 11

name: Handsets
description: number of handsets issued to the account

name: HandsetModels
description: number of distinct handset models issued to the account

name: CurrentEquipmentDays
description: days since the current handset was issued

name: AgeHH1
description: age of the first adult in the household (years)
notes: placeholder: 0 is not a plausible age (13,917 rows)

name: AgeHH2
description: age of the second adult in the household (years), 0 if none or unrecorded
notes: placeholder: 0 is not a plausible age (26,087 rows); ambiguous, may mean no second adult

name: ChildrenInHH
description: whether children are present in the household

name: HandsetRefurbished
description: whether the current handset is refurbished

name: HandsetWebCapable
description: whether the current handset can browse the web

name: TruckOwner
description: whether the household owns a truck

name: RVOwner
description: whether the household owns a recreational vehicle

name: Homeownership
description: whether home-ownership status is known (Known/Unknown), not ownership itself
notes: records whether ownership status is known, not ownership itself

name: BuysViaMailOrder
description: whether the customer buys via mail order

name: RespondsToMailOffers
description: whether the customer responds to mail offers

name: OptOutMailings
description: whether the customer opted out of marketing mailings

name: NonUSTravel
description: whether the customer travels outside the United States

name: OwnsComputer
description: whether the household owns a computer

name: HasCreditCard
description: whether the customer has a credit card on file

name: RetentionCalls
description: number of calls made to the retention team
notes: possible leakage: contact with the retention team may reflect churn intent recorded close to the churn decision

name: RetentionOffersAccepted
description: number of retention offers accepted
notes: possible leakage: contact with the retention team may reflect churn intent recorded close to the churn decision

name: NewCellphoneUser
description: whether the customer is a first-time cellphone user
notes: redundant pair: both No in 34,188 rows (67.0%) means new/not-new status is unknown, not that the customer is neither

name: NotNewCellphoneUser
description: whether the customer is not a first-time cellphone user
notes: redundant pair: both No in 34,188 rows (67.0%) means new/not-new status is unknown, not that the customer is neither

name: ReferralsMadeBySubscriber
description: number of referrals made by the subscriber

name: IncomeGroup
description: household income band, 1 (lowest) to 9 (highest); 0 appears to mean unknown
notes: placeholder: 0 appears to mean unknown income (12,835 rows); bands otherwise run 1 to 9

name: OwnsMotorcycle
description: whether the household owns a motorcycle

name: AdjustmentsToCreditRating
description: number of adjustments made to the customer's credit rating

name: HandsetPrice
description: handset price band in USD
notes: placeholder: 'Unknown' text mixed with a numeric USD price band (28,982 rows)

name: MadeCallToRetentionTeam
description: whether the customer ever called the retention team
notes: possible leakage: contact with the retention team may reflect churn intent recorded close to the churn decision

name: CreditRating
description: ordinal credit-rating band, 1-Highest to 7-Lowest

name: PrizmCode
description: geodemographic segment (PRIZM cluster code)
notes: 'Other' is a vague catch-all (48.3% of rows), reported but not treated as missing

name: Occupation
description: customer's occupation category
notes: 'Other' is a vague catch-all (73.7% of rows), reported but not treated as missing

name: MaritalStatus
description: whether the customer is married (Yes/No); Unknown where not captured
